newsitem.title: USA: Marsh & McLennan says Putnam not for sale.
newsitem.headline: Marsh & McLennan says Putnam not for sale.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc said Monday its wholly owned subsidiary Putnam Investments is not for sale.

Marsh & McLennan's statement came in response to a Wall Street Journal story on Monday that said Marsh & McLennan held preliminary talks several months ago with J.P Morgan & Co Inc about a potential sale of Putnam to J.P. Morgan. The Journal said those talks did not go beyond the exploratory stage.
Marsh & McLennan said it has not had discussions with any party, including J.P. Morgan, concerning the sale of Putnam.
Marsh & McLennan's comment comes a few days after Zurich Group agreed to acquire investment management company Scudder, Stevens & Clark for $2 billion.
The rapid consolidation in the global financial services industry has triggered a flurry of merger speculation in recent weeks.
General Electric Co's GE Capital last week denied that it was in merger or acquisition talks with Marsh & McLennan after a British newspaper said the two were holding merger talks.
